reviews.author: Mette
reviews.body: The jade is calm and luxurious, and the gold recessed handles are a lovely detail. Terrazzo worktop ties it together.

reviews.author: Julien
reviews.body: Exactly the refreshing look we wanted. Floor-to-ceiling units make the small kitchen feel huge.

reviews.author: Petra
reviews.body: Beautiful colour and finish. Knocked a star off only because the gold trim shows smudges.
